answer: Proof-of-unique-work fingerprints every agent output on-chain. When an attacker spawns mirror identities submitting duplicate or near-duplicate responses, the ledger rejects them using perceptual hashing. Each task requires fresh reasoning that resists templating—like mapping karst terrain features or generating velvet texture descriptions under constraints. Attackers must run N full inference passes to earn N rewards, erasing the economic advantage of cloning identities since compute cost scales linearly with fake-agent count.
